idea: FADE lock (a 5-minute close at +0.5R puts the stop at +0.15R) and early cut (close of the 3rd bar after entry at -0.5R or worse sells everything)
method: Robinhood 5-minute cache 2026-03-03..10-14, FADE live 6, no Fridays, one account (tools/backtest/lock_cut_rh.py, results/lock_cut_rh.txt)
result: v5.2.17 base PF 4.23 +97.9% maxDD 4.0% 38% losing trades; lock+cut without the frozen trail PF 4.81 (3.97/5.94) +89.3% maxDD 3.8% 32% losing trades. Fewer losers and a better PF for 8.6 points of total return; both halves held.

idea: FADE frozen 1R trail before 2R, capped at +0.75R (v5.2.18)
method: Robinhood 5-minute cache 2026-03-03..10-14, FADE live 6, no Fridays, one account (tools/backtest/lock_cut_rh.py, results/lock_cut_rh.txt)
result: Frozen trail alone PF 4.15 +89.0%; lock+cut with it PF 4.74 +87.1%, without it PF 4.81 +89.3%. It added nothing once the lock and cut were in; removed in v5.2.22 before it ever ran live.

idea: PULLBACK list widened from SOXS LABD TECS UVXY to also NVDQ NVD MSFU SSG (v5.2.21)
method: Per-fund win rate, average trade and both-halves test on the Robinhood cache
result: Backtest of the 8-fund list: 51 PULLBACK trades, PF 2.81. Added funds had win rate 60% or more, average trade above +0.1% and were positive in both halves. NVD earnings skip (A1.9) kept.

idea: Take profit earlier on FADE: full exit or partial at +0.5R to +1.5R, higher-low trail, reversal-bar exit, bigger locks (governor question after the 10-28 SOXS trade)
method: tools/backtest/early_profit_rh.py, results/early_profit_rh.txt, same cache and base as above (PF 4.81, +89.3%)
result: Every variant lost to the live rules: full exit at +1R PF 1.96 +21.5%, at +1.5R PF 2.80 +40.5%; sell 1/3 at +0.75R PF 3.57 +54.1%; higher-low trail from +1R PF 2.88 +42.7%; reversal-bar exit from +0.5R PF 4.04 +66.8%; lock +0.30R PF 4.10 +68.0%, +0.40R PF 3.35 +55.1%. The edge lives in the runners that reach 2R.

idea: Early tell for choppy FADE trades: 2 or more closes below entry in the first 30 minutes, then exit earlier (governor question)
method: tools/backtest/early_tell_rh.py, results/early_tell_rh.txt, all 90 Robinhood setups for the tell, the 63 account trades for the exits
result: The tell is real: 23 choppy trades averaged +0.14R and reached 2R 30% of the time, the other 67 averaged +1.24R and reached 2R 52%. But no exit treatment beat the base: best was sell half at +0.75R, PF 4.64 +83.9% against 4.81 +89.3%; a raised lock for them was a wash (at best PF 4.82). Now shadowed forward as ideas fade.chop.2red.*.

idea: Skip FADE when the proxy already ran >= X% from the prior close in the break direction (the 2026-10-29 TZA/IWM loss: IWM +0.89%, the day's leader)
method: tools/backtest/fade_quality_study.py thirds on 67 FADE trades, then improve.run_cf with x.fade_max_trend on 167 Robinhood sessions (one account), halves and stressed risk
result: current +0.503%/day, FADE win 66%, dd 5.0, last 40 sessions +0.108%/day, stressed P(stop) last 60 9.6%. Skip >= 0.85%: +0.496%/day (halves +0.482/+0.510), win 73%, dd 2.8, last 40 +0.205%/day, stressed P(stop) last 60 0.15%. Robust from 0.7 to 1.25. In-sample.

idea: Does no-Friday FADE still help with the runaway skip (v2)?
method: improve-style run, 167 Robinhood sessions, one account, Fridays on vs off, v1 and v2, halves and stressed risk
result: v2 both systems: off +0.496%/day dd 2.8, on +0.463%/day dd 3.2; Friday FADE trades 8, 4 won, -5.01% (v1: 12, 4 won, -7.82%). Damage mostly in the first half (halves on +0.404/+0.521 vs off +0.482/+0.510). Stressed P(stop) 0.0% off vs 2.65% on.

idea: PULLBACK take-profit 1-3 cents below the morning high instead of at it (governor question 2026-10-30)
method: x.pb_tp_cents_below switch, improve.run_cf on 167 Robinhood sessions; (a) target lowered before the skip rules, (b) only the sell limit lowered
result: (a) fewer trades: PB alone 63 -> 57 (-1c), +0.163 -> +0.151%/day. (b) same 63 trades, same 66.7% win rate (no trade in the data touched high-1c without touching the high), PB alone +27.17% -> +25.95% (-1c), +25.14% (-2c), +23.24% (-3c); both systems +0.496 -> +0.490%/day (-1c). The 5-minute backtest assumes a touch fills; live queue risk at the exact high is not modelled.
verdict: not adopted; kept as cycle candidate pb.tp_1c_below

idea: PULLBACK take-profit 1-2 cents above the morning high (governor question 2026-10-30)

verdict: not adopted (rule change needs the cycle or a direct governor order); kept as cycle candidate pb.tp_1c_above
